researchBasis.topic: systemd units, credentials, timers, and offline verification
Cloudflare locally managed tunnel ingress and validation
AWS Secrets Manager exact secret retrieval and temporary role credentials
SQLite live backup and journal-safe recovery boundaries

rows.proposedItem: testable app, tunnel, watchdog, backup, and restore-drill systemd units and timers
rows.rationale: The accepted donor owns the units; I00 already adds credential delivery without replacing them. A shadow copy would create a competing service owner.

rows.proposedItem: external watchdog with bounded restart, deploy-lock stand-down, tunnel, freeze, and backup alarms
rows.rationale: The donor watchdog already restarts only on bounded liveness failure and treats readiness failure as alert-only. New watchdog logic is a rejected duplicate.

rows.proposedItem: application-consistent SQLite and evidence backup with integrity, retention, and freshness proof
rows.rationale: The donor uses SQLite online backup and atomic publication; I00 already adds safe-version, full-integrity, and foreign-key gates.

rows.proposedItem: guarded restore and periodic isolated restore drill
rows.rationale: Isolated restore is already checksum and integrity checked, disjoint from DATA_DIR, and exercised with fake paths.

rows.proposedItem: same-filesystem staged, fully verified, retained-prior-set atomic production restore
rows.rationale: Current state is BLOCKED_DONOR_AMENDMENT. Exclusive paths cannot alter the accepted restore owner or invent a shared state-layout contract; OPS-SHADOW records an insertion request only.
The donor owns atomic switching and fail-closed rollback policy; I00 already supplies canonical preflight and delegation.

rows.proposedItem: Cloudflare tunnel and Access templates with loopback origin and terminal refusal rule
rows.rationale: The accepted local tunnel template has placeholders, a numeric loopback origin, and final 404. I00 already adds Access enforcement and readback validation.

rows.proposedItem: least-privilege Secrets Manager IAM template for one exact secret
rows.rationale: The donor exact-resource policy is already tightened by I00 exact-suffix and optional KMS constraints. A new policy owner is unnecessary.

rows.proposedItem: instance-role Secrets Manager provider and systemd credential delivery with fake validation
rows.rationale: The donor omission was already adapted by I00 with exact ARN, AWSCURRENT, ambient-credential refusal, fake CLI injection, 0600 materialization, and non-disclosure tests.

rows.proposedItem: local and fake executable validation of operational templates
rows.rationale: The accepted donor and I00 already provide mock systemctl, loopback fake app, fake AWS, fake SQLite, temporary roots, and hostile fail-closed cases.

rows.proposedItem: packet-local donor parity, classification, scope, and fail-closed conformance harness
rows.rationale: This harness reads and tests accepted owners; it owns no unit, script, provider, state, route, startup seam, or external effect.

rows.proposedItem: RUN-16 donor-first inventory, insertion requests, and immutable shadow receipt
rows.rationale: No RUN-16 packet-local classification or immutable receipt exists at the base. Metadata changes no canonical product state.

rows.proposedItem: real systemd, AWS, Cloudflare, DNS, tunnel, secret, host, deployment, or service mutation
rows.rationale: External activation is owner-gated, unavailable to this packet, and excluded from all claims.

rows.proposedItem: new shadow-owned systemd, watchdog, backup, restore, rollback, tunnel, IAM, or secret-provider implementation
rows.rationale: One concept already has one accepted owner. Creating operational copies inside a fixture namespace would be duplication, not a port.

limitations: The current host is Darwin arm64 and has no systemd-analyze, cloudflared, AWS CLI, or cfn-guard binary; native vendor validation is not claimed.
No full, browser, performance, soak, target-host, or deployment suite is authorized under the same-machine rule.
Production restore remains BLOCKED_DONOR_AMENDMENT and is represented only by a draft insertion request.
Cloudflare local-versus-remote tunnel management must be adjudicated at a future port against the accepted target architecture.
C2 does not exist in this worktree; any possible port waits for C2 and director adjudication.
No target Linux version, filesystem atomic-swap capability, safe SQLite target version, capacity receipt, external paging receipt, or real vendor readback is present.

The broader I00 release/preflight test was attempted but cannot load better-sqlite3 because this worktree has no hydrated node_modules; it is not green evidence, and dependency hydration is outside RUN-16 scope.
